decision_rule.absence_rule: An absent positive or absent negative axiom is never a label and never becomes OBSTRUCTION.
decision_rule.cannot_check_if: rights, byte identity, parsing, namespace authority, explicit negative certificates, conflict freedom or source-family disjointness fails for any family
decision_rule.comparator_rule: Comparator execution remains NOT_EXECUTED and 0/3 execution-ready unless runtime/dependency/resource manifests are separately frozen before outputs.
decision_rule.positive_source_frame_if: all three frozen families pass every admission gate; this licenses only an explicit-direct-axiom semantic calibration frame

all_required: exact repository commit/tree and every selected Git blob identity bound before axiom access
public rights source captured and applicable to frozen ontology bytes
all frozen files transport and match the pre-frozen Git blob SHA-1 plus computed SHA-256
at least one authority-namespace named class identity certificate
at least one authority-namespace explicit direct disjointness certificate
distinct governance family from each other admitted family

next_if_positive: Use this three-family frame only for outcome-blind comparator runtime preflight and direct-negative semantic calibration under a separate freeze; retain the broader naturalistic/OAEI and comparator-execution gaps.
